unsupported: Eagle Automotive Distributors operates as the distribution arm of the Lowe Automotive Group, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri.

The business traces its roots to 1968 when Norman Lowe established the company; after his passing in 1996, his son Jeff Lowe assumed the presidency of both Lowe Automotive Whse. and MAP Automotive Whse., keeping the operation family-owned.
Customers include independent repair shops, installer technicians, fleet maintenance operations, and Ford dealerships — the latter accessing a dedicated Ford WebShop portal.
The company's Midwest footprint targets professional automotive service providers in the St. Louis metro, central Illinois, and southeastern Wisconsin.
